intent.summary: Selects exactly one eligible content branch from a predicate without assigning platform visibility mechanics.
useWhen: Content existence or presentation depends on state
avoidWhen: The element must remain in layout and only its visual style changes

semantics.childPolicy: one true branch and an optional false branch
semantics.sizing: size is that of the active branch
semantics.ordering: active branch occupies the conditional's semantic position

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: Boolean state selecting the active branch.

attributes.name: trueBranch
attributes.description: Pattern subtree active when condition is true.

attributes.name: falseBranch
attributes.description: Pattern subtree active when condition is false.

attributes.name: inactivePolicy
attributes.description: Whether inactive content is absent or retained without layout.

accessibility.focusBehavior: only active content participates in focus order
notes: Focus must move predictably if the focused branch becomes inactive.

mappings.strategy: Choose presence or visibility mechanics from inactivePolicy.
caveats: Collapsed and unloaded content have different state lifetimes.
